## PRB1.3. Safety

-   6 ANSPs achieved the RP4 target level D on safety risk management already in 2025.

-   17 ANSPs achieved the EoSM intermediate targets on all Management Objectives in 2025.

-   Four ANSPs scored minimum level A (below regulatory requirements) at least on one of the Management Objectives.

-   The rate of Runway Incursions (Ris) and Separation Minima Infringements (SMIs) have decreased compared to 2024.
